notes.title: 🌸 Demo Extended Until August 18th! 🌸
notes.content:
We were supposed to say goodbye to you in the village today… but honestly? We’re not ready.
Seeing your screenshots, reading your stories, and hearing how you’ve been enjoying life here has made us want to keep the gates open just a little longer.

✨ So, we’re happy to announce that the Everdream Village demo has been extended until August 18th!
That’s more time to explore, relax, and maybe discover a few things you missed the first time around.

notes.title: 🌊 Swim with us toward World Ocean Day Festival and help us save marine life! 🐳
notes.content:
The ocean is cruicial for our entire planet's ecosystems, producing more oxygen and absorbing more carbon than all the forests combined 💧 This event is all about protecting it and its many incredible inhabitants. 

World Ocean Day Festival is an event by Games For Waves, gaming and streaming community created by Whale and Dolphin Conservation. The goal? To connect gaming industry with real-world conservation efforts. The festival kicks off today and Untold Tales joins in with Everdream Village and many other titles!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39873559/1100d557d97384564b6d41b5b928ce40cf02a4ba.png

🗓️ From June 5th to 12th, we're pledging 20% of our net profits from selected itemsto Whale and Dolphin Conservation and you get to purchase our games at deep discounts. This year, every purchase WDC to protect the ocean and the seas from deadly lost and discarded fishing gear! 🛶🎣🐟
[previewyoutube=7TmAZSZtikA;full][/previewyoutube]
 About Everdream Village

Build your ideal, cozy farm in a living village. Form bonds with fellow villagers to lend a hand as you grow crops, care for animals, and craft a corner of paradise. Sail across enchanted islands to discover new resources and adventures along the way.

It’s about one of the calm and slow moments that just stays with you.

Nothing fancy, just thriving veggies: golden corn, bright tomatoes, and fat pumpkins.🌽 🍅🎃
But the care, the patience, and the kind work you can feel in your heart are what make that picture special!

Take a look at the new page and let it remind you to slow down, breathe deep, and notice the small things around you.
